episodes.title: From Church Basement Trauma to Collective Recovery with Timothy Schraeder Rodriguez
episodes.description:
Episode Summary
In this episode of The Liberated Porch Podcast, host Kit Morgan speaks with Timothy Schrader Rodriguez about surviving conversion therapy, deconstructing harmful theology, and rebuilding a life rooted in authenticity, sobriety, and connection. Tim shares what it was like to move through evangelical megachurch culture, how sobriety became part of his healing, and why reclaiming faith on his own terms changed everything.

01:19 — Conversion therapy and faith crisis

03:10 — Sobriety and reclamation

08:32 — The path to sobriety
10:00 — Sobriety and spiritual healing
12:35 — Shame, addiction, and trauma
14:17 — Celebrate Recovery discussion
16:08 — Family history and addiction awareness
18:11 — Healing through sobriety and therapy
21:05 — The opposite of addiction is connection
25:05 — Real community in recovery
27:42 — Church basements and metaphor
28:46 — Reclaiming the basement
30:10 — Sobriety in queer spaces
31:42 — Friendship and sober curiosity
33:26 — Lessons from the 12 steps
35:21 — Moral inventory and accountability
37:29 — Hope for the book
39:30 — Closing reflection
